facts.title: Morphiq — Interfaces that move.
facts.description: 28 interactive React components — optics, raster, type, mechanics and motion. Each is driven by a model, not a keyframe, and installs as source.

research.name: Morphiq
research.note: 28 React effects driven by physical models, such as spring-chain headlines and SDF refractive glass, installed as source.

effects: Elastic Headline: letters as a mass-spring chain you can grab and pull
Prism Glass refractive lens with spectral dispersion from signed distance fields
Bitmap Image dithering by ordered Bayer or error diffusion
Ferrofluid Nav whose active pill necks and flows between items

unverified: The site says MIT and links github.com/prathamhpatel/morphiq, but that repository returned 404 on 2026-10-24, so openSource is false until a public repository is found.
Several components are marked NEW but no date appears anywhere on the site, so lastUpdated is empty.
